notes.title: NEW GAME - Egghead Gumpty
notes.notes:
[h1][b]WISHLIST[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067570

Explore an infinite procedurally-generated abandoned juvie as you try to survive a monstrous egg with legs named Egghead Gumpty that’s hiding in the building. He can watch you from anywhere, so catch him stalking you before it’s too late in this unique horror experience.

notes.title: Human Apocalypse is released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am Faris, the 19 year old developer behind this game. I am very happy to finally present to you the full version of Human Apocalypse.

[h1][b]Get it here:[/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661900

[previewyoutube=4cU9iW7NKPk;full][/previewyoutube]

I have been making games since I was around 13, I really enjoy game development and it's pretty much a hobby for me. All of them have been for free so far. Some of them you might recognize such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522660/Introvert_A_Teenager_Simulator/]Introvert: A Teenager Simulator[/url]. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590360/He_Needs_His_Medicine/]He Needs His Medicine[/url], etc. You can check and play all of them [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/euphoricbros]here[/url] :D

After some of my games got well-received and players liked them, I decided to tackle one of the crazier ideas I had in my mind since it it was time to make a longer, bigger, better game. That idea is Human Apocalypse and today it just got released! It's my first commercial game.

Thanks for being here and hope you like the game :)

[url=https://discord.com/invite/K6MwbpAuRD]You can join the community and I in the Discord![/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/intent/user?screen_name=Euphoric_Bros]Or follow on Twitter to stay updated![/url]

- Faris, Euphoric Brothers

notes.title: 🎉 Human Apocalypse got selected for the PAX 10 🎉!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Human Apocalypse is in the PAX 10![/b][/h2]

We are very honoured to be selected for this. 
[url=https://west.paxsite.com/en-us/features/the-pax-10.html]PAX 10[/url] is a showcase in [url=https://west.paxsite.com/]PAX West[/url] where each year a group of 50 industry experts select the ten best indie games in regard to gameplay and overall fun-factor.

If you want to attend PAX West 2021 and hang out with us in person, you can [url=https://www.showclix.com/event/paxwest2012451aklsjde]purchase badges here[/url]. Due to Covid-19, they have implemented [url=https://west.paxsite.com/en-us/health-and-safety/health-and-safety-information.html]safety guidelines and policies[/url] to help provide a safe experience. PAX West takes place at the Washington State Convention Center in Seattle on Labor Day Weekend, Friday, September 3 through Monday, September 6.
